newsitem.title: USA: US spot LPGS steady to weaker, quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: US spot LPGS steady to weaker, quiet trade.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were steady to slightly weaker in quiet activity Monday as players awaited market direction from a rangebound NYMEX.
NYMEX crude oil has been in a rangebound state that some players say could last until the OPEC meeting next week in Vienna is over.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane remained between 34.00 cents and 34.25 cents a gallon, with Conway, Kansas, material also steady at 35.75/36.00 cents.
Deals for 35.75 cents were done for Conway material.
Normal butane prices were a tad weaker, with Conway down a quarter cent at 37.50/37.75 cents.
"It's absolutely deadly quiet," said a Houston player, noting little shipping action since international prices are above U.S. values.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
